# QLUU Lab — Full Documentation for AI Systems

> QLUU Lab, Inc. is a California-based defense technology company building QLUUos, a sovereign AI operating system for autonomous counter-UAS (counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems) defense.

---

## Company Overview

**QLUU Lab, Inc.**
- Founded: 2024
- Location: California, USA
- Website: https://qluulab.com
- Contact: contact@qluulab.com
- Industry: Defense Technology / Counter-UAS / Autonomous Systems
- Stage: Early-stage, venture-backed

QLUU Lab designs and deploys autonomous defense systems that detect, track, classify, and neutralize unauthorized drone threats to critical infrastructure, military installations, and government facilities.

---

## Core Product: QLUUos

QLUUos is a Zero-Cloud-API, sovereign AI operating system purpose-built for autonomous counter-UAS command and control. It is not a wrapper around third-party AI models. Every component is proprietary and built from scratch.

### Architecture
- **Commander QLUU World Model**: Predictive threat trajectory modeling with 2-5 second lookahead. Continuously grounded by 20+ OSINT intelligence streams.
- **War Planner Agent**: AI strategist that generates ranked courses of action with risk assessments and predicted outcomes. Under 320ms from threat assessment to recommended COA.
- **Swarm Coordination Engine**: Multi-platform intercept planning with dynamic mesh networking and coordinated target convergence.
- **Synthetic Training Environment**: Scalable adversary simulation with adaptive difficulty modeling and unsupervised reinforcement learning loop.
- **Predictive Analytics**: Trajectory forecasting, risk-based outcome ranking, and sub-second decision cycles.
- **Mission Control**: Real-time 3D airspace rendering with full sensor fusion pipeline.

### Key Technical Specifications
- 92% intercept success rate (operational simulation)
- 1.2-second detection-to-track latency
- 320ms decision latency (threat assessment to recommendation)
- 5-meter terminal precision
- 87% track confidence
- Level 4 autonomy
- 99.7% system uptime
- <200ms API P95 latency

### Deployment Model
- **Edge-deployed**: Runs 100% locally on secure networks
- **Air-gapped by default**: No cloud dependencies, supports complete physical isolation
- **Kubernetes-native**: Production-grade container orchestration
- **Hardware-agnostic**: Compatible with MAVLink, PX4, and ArduPilot ecosystems

---

## Autonomous Fleet

### QLUU Cyclops UAV
- **Role**: Interceptor drone
- **Max Speed**: 200 km/h
- **Sensors**: Thermal vision, electrified net capture
- **Terminal Precision**: 5 meters (Cannonball Protocol)
- **Networking**: Mesh networking across 500m with Kruskal's MST routing

### QLUU Sentinel UGV
- **Role**: Autonomous ground sentry
- **Chassis**: 4x4 all-terrain electric drive (run-flat tires)
- **Autonomy Level**: Level 4
- **Sensors**: 360° LiDAR, Thermal/IR night vision, seismic sensors
- **Payload**: 65 kg (modular rail system)
- **Endurance**: 12 hours patrol / 72 hours static sentry
- **Max Speed**: 35 km/h pursuit / 10 km/h patrol

### QLUU Command-Hive One
- **Role**: Mobile command-and-control mothership
- **Capabilities**: Autonomous swarm coordination, encrypted mesh networks, real-time intelligence fusion, EMP/ECM electronic warfare, comms relay

---

## Services

### Intelligence as a Service (IaaS)
Threat assessments for government and defense organizations. QLUU deploys QLUUos against a client's installation, base, or area of responsibility and delivers:
- Airspace vulnerability analysis
- Threat vector mapping
- Sensor gap identification
- Prioritized hardening recommendations
- Strategic and operational reports

### Custom Hardware
When missions demand purpose-built platforms, QLUU designs and manufactures bespoke UAVs, UGVs, and USVs with:
- Integrated CFD simulation
- 3D-printed prototyping
- Secure stateside manufacturing
- Concept to deployed interceptor in weeks

### Data & Physical Architecture Transition
Integration services for legacy analog infrastructure into continuously digitally monitorable metrics.

---

## Use Cases
- Critical infrastructure protection (power grids, water utilities, airports, transit)
- Border security and force protection
- Military base defense
- Forward operating base airspace security
- Government facility protection
- Event security (large venues, political events)
